job.title: In Store Wrappers
job.description:
Join Our In-Store Floral Team!

Do you have a passion for flowers, creativity and providing great customer service?

We are currently seeking 2–3 enthusiastic Florists / Floral Wrappers to join our client's in-store floral team at West End, Brisbane.

Our client is a market leader in wholesale fresh flowers and potted products, supplying beautiful floral products to major retailers across Australia.

This is initially a 4-week assignment with potential for extension. The team will be providing coverage across all 7 days of the week. The weekly roster will be shared between the successful candidates.

About the Role

As a Floral Wrapper, you will play a key role in maintaining an attractive and well-presented floral display while assisting customers with bouquet wrapping and providing valuable feedback.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Wrap bouquets for customers in a professional and attractive manner
  • Maintain a tidy, full, and visually appealing floral display
  • Replenish stock and ensure displays remain well-presented throughout the day
  • Capture images of displays as required
  • Checking flowers and plants for quality and freshness
  • Maintaining a clean, organised and safe work area

About You

We're looking for people who genuinely enjoy working with flowers and interacting with customers.

You will ideally have:

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills
  • Previous experience in floristry is essential
  • A creative eye and strong attention to presentation
  • Good time management and organisational skills
  • The ability to work independently and take responsibility for your work area
  • A reliable and flexible approach to rostered work

Hours & Availability

The in store wrappers team operates 7 days per week, with shifts shared across a team of 2–3 florists.

Typical shifts are expected to be approximately 8:00am to 4:00pm, however start and finish times may vary depending on operational requirements.

We're therefore looking for candidates who can offer flexibility across weekdays and weekends.

You won't necessarily work every day — the roster will be divided across the team to provide consistent seven-day coverage.

Why Join Us?

This is a fantastic opportunity to work with a leading floral business while doing what you love in a customer-facing retail environment.

You'll enjoy:

  • A roster shared across a small in-store team
  • The opportunity to use and develop your floristry skills
  • A creative, hands-on role with plenty of customer interaction
  • Working with beautiful fresh flowers and potted products every day

If you're passionate about floristry, take pride in creating beautiful displays and enjoy helping customers find the perfect flowers, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply with your current resume and ensure your application includes an up-to-date email address and mobile number so we can contact you regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

job.title: Production Workers

  • 6:00am – 2:30pm
  • $34.80 per hour
  • Full training provided
  • Opportunities to learn and train across multiple departments
  • Opportunity to build a long-term career with an industry leader

Key Responsibilities

  • Working efficiently and safely on a production line
  • Removing and replacing labels on gas bottles
  • Sorting and organising empty gas bottles
  • Placing filled gas bottles into designated cages
  • Undertaking training across different departments as required

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in production, manufacturing, warehousing or labouring
  • A strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • The ability to safely lift up to 20kg
  • A valid Driver’s Licence and reliable transport
  • A strong commitment to workplace health and safety

If you're looking for a stable, Monday-to-Friday opportunity with great training and the potential to develop your skills, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply now with a copy of your resume and our team will be in contact with you.

job.title: Yard & Logistics Operator
job.description:

Seeking a reliable and experienced Yard and Logistics Operator to work in a busy, hands-on role at our depot in Nudgee. An opportunity to work in a diverse role, from coordinating deliveries, operating forklifts, manual assembly of bins using hand and power tools, site inspections and safety checks, and supporting airport servicing operations. This role pays above award wages, family-friendly hours, and the opportunity to join a safety-focused team.

  • Home every night, working Monday to Friday 6.00am to 3.00pm
  • $45.63/hour plus Penalties and 12% Superannuation
  • Opportunity to move into a permanent position

Key Responsibilities:

To be successful in this role, you will have a proven track record of

  • Safe Operation of a forklift, holding a current licence
  • Yard hand and labouring experience
  • Must be fit and healthy, being able to pass a Pre-Employment Medical and Drug and Alcohol Screen

  • Site Inspections with strong communication skills experience essential
  • Full Working Rights for at least 40 hours a week for a long-term role required
  • Residency in reasonable proximity to the site

How to Apply:

Simply "Apply Now" on the link provided.
